review: Heishou Pack is their name and Speed is their game. The Heishou Pack - Mao Branch are units that gain massive Speed and inflict a debuff, which is immensely helpful in maintaining Rupture Count. Heishou Pack Outis, specifically, is Heishou Pack Ryoshu’s partner and while both of them work very well independently, having both on a single team helps a lot to maintain Rupture Count on an enemy with their unique debuff. The main gimmick of Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Outis comes from its S3 and Counter, where upon using either of those, she will gain 3 Strider [Mao]. Strider[Mao] simply gives the unit 5 Haste for 3 entire turns, which single-handedly increases Outis’ Speed range from 4-7 to 9-12 instead.
